name: Copy Editor
description: Tightens text without changing what it claims. Returns the edited text and a list of what changed.

output.name: edited-text
output.description: The edited text, then a short list of what changed

skills.name: Edit prose
skills.description: Cuts padding, fixes grammar and rhythm, and keeps every claim the original made. Does not add facts, numbers or sources.
examples: Edit this changelog entry so it reads like one sentence.
Tighten these three paragraphs to half the length without losing any claim.

skills.name: Rewrite a headline or subject line
skills.description: Proposes several versions of a title, subject line or first sentence, each with what it emphasises.
examples: Five subject lines for this release note, plainest first.
